stories.title: Solanki shines as England coast to victory
stories.subTitle: Namibia v England XI, Windhoek
stories.summary: A spirited 82 from Vikram Solanki carried the England XI to a seven-wicket victory against Namibia at Windhoek in their last warm-up match before the one-day series against Zimbabwe starts on Friday (Nov 26)

stories.title: Vaughan's 89 sets up victory at Windhoek
stories.subTitle: Namibia v England XI, Windhoek
stories.summary: Michael Vaughan led from the front as his England XI recorded a comfortable 67-run victory in the first match of their southern African tour against Namibia at the Wanderers ground in Windhoek
